ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens (spinach-like leaves, some with lighter pale green stems and veins), flat and slightly glossy, piled loosely in a cluster covering roughly 25% of the plate's left side, leaves about 5-8 cm long, with scattered thin red/orange shreds and a few pale white slivers mixed in | 60
ITEM 2 | Shredded pale white and orange mixture (finely cut white cabbage-like strands with thin orange carrot shreds), slightly moist with a lightly glossy sheen, mounded in a loose heap about 7 cm across and 2 cm high on the right-center of the plate, with some strands lying flat and tangled | 70
ITEM 3 | Cubed pale yellow fruit with firm, smooth-looking cut faces and slightly translucent edges, pieces roughly 2-3 cm on each side, cut into irregular blocky cubes, scattered in a cluster along the right side of the plate next to the shredded mixture, moist surfaces with slight sheen | 120
